title: Authenticated Remote Bridge telemetry can trigger destructive local SOAR response
recommendation: Give remote evidence a non-overridable transport origin, reject it from local response, and address any approved remote action to a stable endpoint/process generation through a typed authorized fleet command.

title: Threat Intel reports staged proposals as executed fixes
recommendation: Render staged, executed, and verified as separate states and reserve fixed/applied wording for a typed operation with a passed postcondition and authenticated receipt.

title: No-fix and AI-outage states can hide real KEV vulnerabilities
recommendation: Keep no-fix CVEs active, remove AI-driven bulk ignore, and use separate expiring states for false positive, accepted risk, and compensating control.

title: Sandbox self-tests can leave every detector stopped indefinitely
recommendation: Run self-tests in a restricted subprocess with a hard deadline and make EventBus/sensor restoration independent of worker completion.

title: Release builds trust version pins without artifact hashes
recommendation: Use a reviewed hash-locked wheelhouse with --require-hashes and pin/verify the Inno compiler rather than trusting the mutable runner tool image.

title: One-click Setup accepts rollback to an older vulnerable build
recommendation: Persist and enforce a protected monotonic installed version, reject downgrades by default, and require a separately audited recovery flow for intentional rollback.
